document: Candidate confirmation requires version checks, editable title and ignore reason.

requirements.title: Candidate confirmation requires version checks
requirements.description: Reviewer confirms only the candidate version currently displayed.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Confirm succeeds with the current version and fails with a stale version.

requirements.title: Ignoring a candidate requires a reason
requirements.description: Reviewer must provide an audit reason when ignoring a parsed requirement.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Ignore without reason is rejected; ignore with reason stores ignoredReason.

expected.title: Ignoring a candidate requires a reason

document: Webhook imports must validate timestamp, signature, idempotency key and event version.

requirements.title: Webhook validates HMAC signatures
requirements.description: Incoming CUSTOM_API events must use X-VA signature headers.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Invalid signatures are rejected and a rejected webhook event is recorded.

requirements.title: Webhook replay keeps idempotency
requirements.description: Repeated eventId or idempotencyKey with the same payload returns the existing import.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Same payload is idempotent; different payload returns conflict.

document: Users upload Word, PDF and OCR image files. The platform must enforce binary size limits, parse text and require OCR configuration for scanned files.

requirements.title: Multipart document upload accepts real files
requirements.description: The import API accepts multipart/form-data with projectId, sourceType and file fields.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Uploading a valid docx file creates pending requirement candidates with sourceRef traceability.

requirements.title: OCR processing is bounded by runtime limits
requirements.description: OCR command execution must respect timeout, max output length and concurrent process limits.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: When the OCR command times out or the concurrency limit is reached, the import fails with a readable error and no secret or raw binary is logged.

requirements.title: Scanned PDF requires OCR provider
requirements.description: Image-only PDFs cannot be treated as text PDFs unless an OCR provider is configured.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: A scanned PDF without OCR configuration returns validation failure and stores a failed import record.

expected.title: Multipart document upload accepts real files
OCR processing is bounded by runtime limits

document: Webhook signing secrets can live in local encrypted storage or an external Vault/KMS provider. Fallback can be disabled in production.

requirements.title: Webhook secrets resolve through SecretProvider first
requirements.description: The resolver tries registered SecretProvider implementations before property fallback.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: A provider value wins over a configured fallback value for the same secretRef.

requirements.title: External Vault and KMS providers use references only
requirements.description: The platform stores secretRef and provider metadata while plaintext is returned only by the external resolve endpoint.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Provider requests include purpose and scope context; responses and audit output never expose the resolved secret value.

requirements.title: Production can disable local webhook secret fallback
requirements.description: Operators can require all webhook secrets to resolve through SecretProvider.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: When fallback is disabled, unknown secret references are rejected before signature validation succeeds.

expected.title: Webhook secrets resolve through SecretProvider first
External Vault and KMS providers use references only
Production can disable local webhook secret fallback

document: Reviewers edit AI candidates, preview publish changes and publish confirmed requirements into WP3 assets.

requirements.title: Publish dry run returns create and update plans
requirements.description: The publish API must show what will be created, updated, skipped or conflicted before committing.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Dry run does not create WP3 assets and returns plannedCreateCount, plannedUpdateCount, conflictCount and record details.

requirements.title: Repeated external requirement ids update existing assets
requirements.description: Candidates with an existing externalRequirementId should link or update instead of creating duplicates.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Formal publish sets existingRequirementId for matched assets and keeps sourceRef and sourceUrl traceability.

requirements.title: Candidate review keeps optimistic locking
requirements.description: Edits and confirmations must include the version last displayed by the reviewer.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: A stale version returns conflict and leaves the candidate unchanged.

expected.title: Publish dry run returns create and update plans
Repeated external requirement ids update existing assets
